title: Shipping a new feature to every customer
variant: Dense two-column flow under ruled headings
prompt: A pre-launch checklist for shipping a new feature in our B2B SaaS.
note: Dense and wide because the reader is a launch lead who wants all five areas on one laptop screen, so the groups flow through two CSS columns under bare ruled headings rather than cards, every item is a short clause at 13 pixels with an owner chip in mono at the row's end, and priority is a single filled flag glyph so a row rarely wraps. The ten items that usually go wrong carry a small numbered superscript that links to a tips column on the right, which drops below the groups on a narrow screen and onto the second sheet in print, and the counter is a mono fraction in the header's right corner beside the legend.
